div.div:
Typing one character re-renders Page, which builds a new array and a new function, so memo(List) compares two objects that are never Object.is equal and re-renders anyway.
You pay for the comparison and get nothing.

div.div:
Both props keep the same reference until items changes, so the shallow compare succeeds and List — plus its whole subtree — is skipped.
All three have to agree, or none of them help.
